eyebrow: T-SQL for Database Administrators · Chapter Two
subtitle: Lesson 7 · DBA Monitoring with T-SQL

code:
SELECT r.session_id, r.status, r.cpu_time,
       r.logical_reads, r.wait_type,
       r.blocking_session_id
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
WHERE r.session_id <> @@SPID
ORDER BY r.cpu_time DESC;
caption: Sort by cpu_time or logical_reads to surface the most expensive request.

code:
SELECT r.session_id, r.cpu_time,
       t.text AS query_text, p.query_plan
FROM sys.dm_exec_requests AS r
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(r.sql_handle) AS t
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_query_plan(r.plan_handle) AS p
WHERE r.session_id <> @@SPID
ORDER BY r.cpu_time DESC;
caption: CROSS APPLY resolves sql_handle and plan_handle into readable text and plan.
